_how_it_works: Can't-Miss Shows (HOT) in the Next 30 Days view. Only shows listed here are featured. Order = priority: the site features the first 5 that are in the next 30 days, pass the visitor's filters and aren't canceled, postponed or sold out, and shows them soonest first; when one passes, the next moves up. Each entry names an event in events.json by its exact 'link' AND 'date' (the site's event ID); a multi-night pick also lists every night in 'nights' (each its own link + date, plus a verified event-specific 'tickets' URL when one exists) and, when the seller only has one page for all nights, a 'sharedTickets' {url, label}. The first approved pick is shown as the full-width lead card. with one specific 'why' line, the 'signals' it meets, short 'evidence' links and the date the evidence was 'checked'. A show qualifies with ONE STRONG signal: breakout momentum (a rising artist with a recent, citable breakout in roughly the last 12-18 months: outgrowing rooms since their last Arizona show, dates selling out or upgraded this tour, a first Hot 100/Billboard 200 entry, a viral single with real coverage, a Best New Artist nod, a fast climb up festival bills); a multi-night run in a big room; a date added or venue upgraded because of demand; a rare or returning Arizona stop (first time in years, reunion, comeback, farewell tour, an artist who rarely tours or usually skips Arizona); a hometown release show or homecoming; a one-off collaboration. Or TWO different SUPPORTING signals: headliner scale (size alone isn't enough, so legacy acts need a second, specific reason), a multi-night club run, an earlier sold-out run, new release or award news, an anniversary show, a co-headline or distinctive local lineup, low tickets reported by the seller. Never use follower or stream counts on their own. Suggestions arrive weekly in hot-candidates.json; check the evidence before approving.
